components.shared_root_problem: An active execution schema and a living campaign registry remain insufficiently separated as schema-versus-live-or-historical-campaign-state surfaces.
components.shared_surface_pattern: Active schema plus living campaign-state registry.

components.shared_root_problem: Proposal or induction patch records remain present as registry authority candidates without a clean boundary distinguishing non-live proposal material from current live state.
components.shared_surface_pattern: Proposal-like patch records with file statuses PROPOSED/proposed/proposed_for_induction/registered_late and similar.
components.current_live_authority_candidate: The patch record path itself under registry/governance/patches or governance/.

components.shared_root_problem: Partial patch records can still be read as live authority surfaces without a bounded distinction between partial inventory or closeout records and settled live state.
components.shared_surface_pattern: Partial patch records remaining in registry authority space.

components.shared_root_problem: Executed or pass-status patch records are still typed as proposal surfaces, leaving an unresolved live-versus-proposal boundary.
components.shared_surface_pattern: Registry patch records with file status EXECUTED or PASS but queue authority_state PROPOSAL.
components.current_live_authority_candidate: The executed patch record path itself.

components.shared_root_problem: Applied patch records remain typed as historical while role-aware patch lookup still allows the same surfaces as current registry authority candidates.
components.shared_surface_pattern: Registry patch records with file status APPLIED and queue authority_state HISTORICAL.
components.current_live_authority_candidate: The applied historical patch record path itself.

components.shared_root_problem: Duplicate canonical-looking surfaces share the same patch identity, creating an identity and documentation problem rather than a live-versus-history problem.
components.shared_surface_pattern: Alias pair for the same patch_id.
